lines: Part seventeen gave a forecast a direction. Part eighteen asks what happens between the integer steps: can the Fibonacci step be cut into a smooth flow?
第十七部给预报定下了方向。第十八部追问整数步之间发生了什么：Fibonacci 的一步，能否切成一条光滑的流？
It can, but only by paying a phase. The integers fix every step but not the path between them, and a real flow needs a third dimension.
可以，但必须付出一个相位。整数点确定了每一步，却不确定步与步之间的路径；而一条实的流需要第三个维度。
The Auric FIB atom pyramid, part eighteen: hyperbolic geometry and the phase boundary.
Auric FIB 原子金字塔，第十八部：双曲几何与相位边界。
Stretch, reflect, rotate, and keep the source.
伸缩、反射、旋转，并守住来源。

Fix one branch of the logarithm, and Fibonacci becomes a complex curve: F of t equals phi to the t minus a decaying spiral, over root five. At every integer it lands exactly on F n, negative ones included.
固定对数的一个分支，Fibonacci 就成了一条复曲线：F(t) 等于 φ 的 t 次方减去一个衰减的螺旋，再除以根号五。在每个整数点，它都精确落在 F_n 上，负整数也不例外。

Its real part is growth minus a damped cosine; its imaginary part is a damped sine. At one half it reads zero point five six nine plus zero point three five two i, and reversing time multiplies by minus e to the i pi t, not by plus or minus one.
实部是增长减去一个衰减余弦，虚部是一个衰减正弦。在二分之一处，它读作 0.569 + 0.352i；时间反向乘上的是 −e^(iπt)，而不是正负一。

The composition step M, zero one, one one, splits exactly into a reflection and a stretch. S, two M minus the identity over root five, is a mirror: symmetric, its square the identity, its determinant minus one.
组成步 M = [[0,1],[1,1]] 可以精确拆成一次反射和一次伸缩。S = (2M − I)/√5 是一面镜子：对称，平方为单位，行列式为负一。

The stretch e to the a S has determinant one and keeps area. Since sinh a is one half and cosh a is root five over two, a one, two, root five right triangle holds the whole step: M equals S times e to the a S.
伸缩 e^(aS) 的行列式为一，保持面积。因为 sinh a = 1/2、cosh a = √5/2，一个一、二、根号五的直角三角形装下了整个一步：M = S·e^(aS)。
Can the real plane carry a half step? No. The half step squared would be M, but a real square has a nonnegative determinant, and the determinant of M is minus one.
实平面能承载半步吗？不能。半步的平方应当是 M，可实矩阵平方的行列式非负，而 M 的行列式是负一。

In the complex plane it works. U of t has entries F of t minus one, F of t and F of t plus one, obeys the group law, and has determinant e to the minus i pi t: a complex Cassini identity that turns the sign minus one to the n into a phase.
在复平面里可以。U(t) 的元素是 F(t−1)、F(t)、F(t+1)，满足群律，行列式为 e^(−iπt)：一条复 Cassini 恒等式，把符号 (−1)ⁿ 变成了相位。
Or stay real and add one dimension. The growing direction stretches by e to the a t, while the shrinking direction spirals inside a plane, turning by pi per step as it decays.
或者保持为实，再加一个维度。增长方向按 e^(at) 伸长，收缩方向则在一个平面里旋进：每一步转过 π，同时衰减。
At every integer, positive or negative, this three-dimensional flow lands exactly on M to the n. Two dimensions are impossible, so three is the minimum for a real linear flow of the whole plane.
在每个整数点，无论正负，这条三维流都精确落在 Mⁿ 上。二维不可能，所以对整个平面的实线性流而言，三维是最小的。
But reading only the real shadow loses track. At half time the shadow erases the shrinking direction entirely, so two different inputs cast the same shadow.
可只读实的投影会跟丢。在半时刻，投影把收缩方向整个抹去，于是两个不同的输入投下同一个影子。
Half a step later the difference returns, multiplied by psi. The relation was not erased; it turned into the unread coordinate. The real shadow is not a sufficient state.
再过半步，差异回来了，乘上了 ψ。关系没有被抹掉，只是转进了没读的坐标。实投影不是充分状态。
Nor do the integers choose the curve. Every odd frequency gives a branch that hits every F n and obeys the recurrence for all real t, yet the branches part ways between the integers.
整数点也选不出唯一的曲线。每个奇数频率都给出一个分支：它们经过所有 F_n，对所有实数 t 满足递推，却在整数之间分道扬镳。
Even one fixed branch can be modulated: add lambda e to the a t times sine two pi t, and every integer value and the recurrence survive. A smooth interpolation is a choice, not a consequence.
即便固定一个分支，也还能调制：加上 λ·e^(at)·sin(2πt)，所有整数值和递推都保持不变。光滑插值是一种选择，而不是推论。
Now return to the five modes. Each carries a composition with quantities zero, two, five, seven and three, and the whole mean curve of a law is u F of t plus three, plus v F of t plus four.
回到五种模式。每种模式带着一个组成，数量分别是零、二、五、七、三；一个概率律的整条均值曲线是 u·F(t+3) + v·F(t+4)。

Two numbers decide the whole curve, so a two-dimensional fibre of laws stays invisible at every time. Half on empty and half on five, against half on two and half on three, trace the same curve forever.
两个数就决定整条曲线，所以概率律有一个二维纤维，在任何时刻都看不见。一半落空、一半落五，对比一半落二、一半落三，永远画出同一条曲线。

The native reader separates them. Continuing with window five, the replies are five, rejected, twenty-six, rejected and eighteen, and their law, together with the curve, recovers all five probabilities.
原生读者能把它们分开。以窗口 [5] 继续，回复分别是五、拒绝、二十六、拒绝、十八；这些回复的概率律，加上那条曲线，就恢复全部五个概率。

A native null window already sees the half-time loss: two positive laws with the same shadow get next means that differ by epsilon psi cubed times two plus three psi. Lean has frozen the exact version: at each length, the null reply separates every legal source.
一个原生空窗口就已经能看见半时刻的损失：两个正的、投影相同的律，下一次均值相差 ε·ψ³·(2+3ψ)。Lean 已冻结确定性的版本：在每个长度上，空窗口回复能分开每个合法来源。
Phi and its inverse are a pair of stretches, minus one to the n is a reflection, e to the minus i pi t is the phase in between, and the real shadow is one projection of a three-dimensional flow.
φ 与它的倒数是一对互逆伸缩，(−1)ⁿ 是一次反射，e^(−iπt) 是其间的相位，而实投影只是一条三维流的一个影子。

Lean has frozen the native null reply that separates every legal source. The continuous lift, the obstruction, the fibres and the replies are argued in the theory volume with the classical Binet and Cassini identities, and every number here was recomputed for this film.
Lean 已冻结能分开每个合法来源的原生空窗口回复。连续提升、障碍、纤维与回复在理论卷中论证，并用到经典的 Binet 与 Cassini 恒等式；这里的每个数字都为这部片子重新计算过。
